These signals are directional references, not a basis for employment decisions.
For real-time data, refer to job platforms and official releases.
market_signal_card.intro: Recruitment and industry signals show warehouse requirements shifting from manual work toward systems and data.
signals: Recruitment commonly requires WMS or ERP familiarity
More automated warehouse projects are consolidating operating roles
Demand is growing for digital supply-chain planning and analysis roles
Cross-border and overseas warehouses continue hiring

market_signal_card.intro: 从招聘与行业信号看，仓管岗位的要求在从「会干活」转向「会系统、会数据」。
signals: 招聘普遍要求熟悉 WMS 或 ERP 系统
自动化仓储项目增多，操作岗位合并
供应链数字化岗位（计划、数据分析）需求增长
跨境仓储与海外仓岗位持续招聘
